title: Comms Plan
description: The audience x channel build plan. Stage 2 writes the matrix and the requirement (message) map; Stage 3 fills in drafted content and sources; Stage 4 builds from it; Stage 5 audits against it. Mirrors proposal_plan.schema.json's shape — a slide is here a channel_run, one per audience x channel cell that was actually selected.

brief_ref.description: Path to the change_brief.json this plan answers

registry_ref.description: Path to channel_registry.json used for this run, with the version it was read at

registry_version.description: channel_registry.json's version field at plan time. route_channels.py (Part 2) refuses to build against a mismatched registry version.

coverage_matrix.description: Explicit audience x channel selection, built before drafting. Every audience id must appear; a value of [] is a deliberate 'no channel reaches this audience' finding, not an omission, and fails Stage 5's coverage check unless every message aimed at that audience is marked non-mandatory.

channel_runs.description: One entry per audience x channel cell actually built. Order does not imply sequencing.

message_ids.description: Message ids this channel run is answering for this audience. Union across all channel_runs for an audience must cover every mandatory message aimed at it.

status.description: Where this run is in the pipeline. planned channels (short_form_video, explainer_video) stop at 'drafted' with a narration_spec.json rather than reaching 'built'.

blocks.description: Content units for this channel run — a subject line, a body paragraph, a slide bullet, a caption line

kind.description: What role this block plays in the channel's format

content.description: String for prose/subject/cta, array for bullets/captions, object for table

sources.description: Message ids (M1..) and/or knowledge-bank entry ids this content came from. MUST be non-empty unless gap is true — no third state. Identical rule to proposal_plan.schema.json's block sources.

gap.description: True when neither the brief nor the knowledge bank has coverage. Renders as a visible [GAP]; never substitute generated filler.

gap_note.description: Required when gap is true — what is missing and which message/audience it leaves exposed

constraint_check.description: Filled by route_channels.py / qa_comms.py (Part 2) against channel_registry.json's constraints for this channel — e.g. subject length, word count, slide count

build_output.description: Path to the produced artifact once Stage 4 runs — a .docx/.pptx path, a Canva design URL, or (for planned channels) the narration_spec.json path
